meta_description:
4,176 likes, 20 comments - delish on October 28, 2026: "I mean, if this doesn’t win the costume contest, then I don’t know what will.

@tiffanithiessen joins SNACKS! to talk about the food memories that shaped her—from her grandmother’s baked beans and spicy applesauce with Red Hots to her go-to cucumber, feta, and dill snack.

The Saved by the Bell and Beverly Hills, 90210 star also reveals what craft services was really like on set, shares her best leftover food hacks, defends cold meatloaf, discusses her new Disney series Coven Academy, and explains why every good girls’ night needs homemade pasta, charcuterie, wine, or an extra-dirty martini.

Click the link in our bio to watch now—stream SNACKS! on Apple, Spotify, and YouTube!".
